xna-type.name: RasterizerState
xna-type.summary: Contains rasterizer state, which determines how to convert vector data (shapes) into raster data (pixels).

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the rasterizer class.

property.name: CullMode
property.summary: Specifies the conditions for culling or removing triangles. The default value is CullMode.CounterClockwise.

property.name: DepthBias
property.summary: Sets or retrieves the depth bias for polygons, which is the amount of bias to apply to the depth of a primitive to alleviate depth testing problems for primitives of similar depth. The default value is 0.
property.remarks: A polygon with a larger z-bias value appears in front of a polygon with a smaller value. For example, a polygon with a value of 1 is is appears drawn in front of a polygon with a value of 0.

property.name: FillMode
property.summary: The fill mode, which defines how a triangle is filled during rendering. The default is FillMode.Solid.

property.name: MultiSampleAntiAlias
property.summary: Enables or disables multisample antialiasing. The default is true.
property.remarks: When multisample antialiasing is enabled, full-scene antialiasing is performed by calculating sampling locations at different sample positions for each multiple sample. When disabled, each multiple sample is written with the same sample value (sampled at a pixel center) which allows non-antialiased rendering to a multisample buffer. This property has no effect when rendering to a buffer that does not support multisampling.

property.name: ScissorTestEnable
property.summary: Enables or disables scissor testing. The default is false.
property.remarks: Scissor testing can improve drawing performance by only drawing triangles (or parts of triangles) that are contained within a ScissorRectangle .

property.name: SlopeScaleDepthBias
property.summary: Gets or sets a bias value that takes into account the slope of a polygon. This bias value is applied to coplanar primitives to reduce aliasing and other rendering artifacts caused by z-fighting. The default is 0.
property.remarks: An application can help ensure that coplanar polygons are rendered properly by adding a bias to the z-values that the system uses when rendering sets of coplanar polygons. The following formula shows how to calculate the bias to be applied to coplanar primitives. bias = ( m × SlopeScaleDepthBias ) + DepthBias Where m is the maximum depth slope of the triangle being rendered, defined as: m = max ( abs (delta z / delta x), abs (delta z / delta y) )

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

field.name: CullClockwise
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for culling primitives with clockwise winding order.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: CullMode = CullMode.CullClockwiseFace,

field.name: CullCounterClockwise
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for culling primitives with counter-clockwise winding order.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: CullMode = CullMode.CullCounterClockwiseFace,

field.name: CullNone
field.summary: A built-in state object with settings for not culling any primitives.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: CullMode = CullMode.None,
